# Youth Capital

> Youth Capital is Morocco's first digital civic governance simulation platform. Young Moroccans take on roles in a simulated Moroccan Parliament, Ministries, and Regional Councils to debate policy, propose bills, respond to simulated crises, and build real leadership and civic-engagement skills.

Youth Capital is not affiliated with the Moroccan government, Parliament, or any political party — it is an independent, youth-run civic education and leadership platform inspired by Morocco's real governance structures.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.youthcapital.org/): overview of the simulation and how to join.
- [About](https://www.youthcapital.org/about): mission, structure, and the team behind Youth Capital.
- [Apply](https://www.youthcapital.org/apply): how to register and apply for a simulation role (Minister, MP, Regional Councillor, Diaspora Representative).
- [Press](https://www.youthcapital.org/press): reports and briefings from simulation sessions.
- [Events](https://www.youthcapital.org/events): upcoming parliamentary sessions and ministry briefings.
- [Rules](https://www.youthcapital.org/rules): the official rulebook covering membership, roles, and conduct.
